item.title: Minor Update - 07-01-2026
item.description:
- Shiv: Alt Fire ammo cost reduced from 5 to 4

- Shiv: Weapon now has fixed pellet spread

- Shiv: Slice and Dice is now back to doing spirit damage and reducing Spirit Resistance from enemies

- Shiv: Slice and Dice damage increased from 60 to 75

- Shiv: Killing Blow T3 reduced from +10% Enemy Health Threshold to +8%

item.description:
